# 📊 Benchmark

<!-- Generated by training/benchmark.py. Edit the script, not this file. -->

**held-out seeds 15-19** · 85 recorded runs · 68 passed (80%) · median latency 80.4 ms per frame

![Pass rate by scenario](images/benchmark.svg)

A run **passes** when the final cart is exactly right *and* checkout is blocked only when it should be (the unknown package). Every run is synthetic and was rendered offline by Unity from a fixed seed, so it can be reproduced exactly. See [training.md](training.md#-scenario-benchmark) for how to record and score runs.

Cameras: **lane, overhead** · coordinates: **calibrated carry-height plane** · seeds: **15, 16, 17, 18, 19**. Model and source hashes are recorded in the JSON report. Identity switches, phantom counts and detection recall are scored against **lane-camera annotations only**; an overhead-only observation can therefore count as a phantom. Exact-cart and review scores use the complete fused output.

## 🔎 Why runs fail

The most common review reasons the ledger reported, per scenario:

- **hands**: Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal; Product first observed beyond checkout boundary
- **shopper**: Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal
- **flatbed**: Conflicting SKU evidence on the same physical object; Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal
- **edge**: Conflicting SKU evidence on the same physical object; Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal
- **stacked**: Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal; Barcode disagrees with how the product looks
- **distractors**: Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal
- **parked**: Entered merchandise disappeared before an observed checkout or reverse removal; Product first observed beyond checkout boundary
- **lumber**: Product first observed beyond checkout boundary; Conflicting SKU evidence on the same physical object

## 📖 Column guide

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| False adds / Missed | Units charged that weren't purchased / purchased units that weren't charged, summed over runs |
| ID switches | Times a real box's matched canonical object ID changed. Lower means steadier identity. |
| Phantom objects | Canonical objects that never matched a real product, usually distractors or occluders detected as merchandise |
| Blocked for review | Share of runs that ended needing an associate or still waiting on an item |
| By barcode | Share of charged items whose SKU came from a decoded barcode. The rest were recognized by look. |
| Assist items | Items handed to an associate (unscanned, unknown barcode, conflicting evidence), summed over runs |
| Detection recall | Share of frames where an in-frame product was matched to a tracked detection (amodal boxes, IoU ≥ 0.3), so heavy occlusion lowers it |
